hook: Windows volume leveling, rebuilt for Linux audio.
hookText: Windows volume leveling, rebuilt for Linux audio

beats.say: Windows Loudness Equalization, the feature that evens out playback volume, has been reverse-engineered from the Windows audio driver and ported to PipeWire on Linux.
It evens out the volume of each application's playback stream, so quiet and loud parts play at a similar level.
Under the hood it sums power into twenty-five frequency bands with edges from one hundred hertz to twenty-four thousand hertz, and the gain it applies is capped at twenty decibels.
